title: Identify members who both attended a closed 'Game' event between March 15,
question: Identify members who both attended a closed 'Game' event between March 15, 2019 and March 20, 2020, and submitted an approved expense over $50 during 2019. Return their full names and majors.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036", mj."XCL_031"
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS mj ON m."XCL_042" = mj."XCL_030"
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON a."XCL_001" = e."XCL_010"
    WHERE e."XCL_013" = 'Game'
      AND e."XCL_016" = 'Closed'
      AND DATE(SUBSTRING(e."XCL_012", 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex."XCL_021" = 'true'
      AND ex."XCL_020" > 50
      AND SUBSTRING(ex."XCL_019", 1, 4) = '2019'
)
